items.question: Combien de spécialités associent paracétamol et codéine ?
items.gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT cis FROM compositions WHERE nature_composant = 'SA'
  GROUP BY cis
  HAVING SUM(sans_accents(substance) LIKE '%PARACETAMOL%') > 0
     AND SUM(sans_accents(substance) LIKE '%CODEINE%') > 0
)
